title: Rarities (UK album)
content:
The Beatles’ albums in order – complete list! » Rarities (UK album)

Recorded: 1962-1969
Producer: George Martin

Released: 2 November 1978

Tracklisting

‘Across The Universe’
‘Yes It Is’
‘This Boy’
‘The Inner Light’
‘I’ll Get You’
‘Thank You Girl’
‘Komm, Gib Mir Deine Hand’
‘You Know My Name (Look Up The Number)’
‘Sie Liebt Dich’
‘Rain’
‘She’s A Woman’
‘Matchbox’
‘I Call Your Name’
‘Bad Boy’
‘Slow Down’
‘I’m Down’
‘Long Tall Sally’

Rarities was a compilation album released in the United Kingdom in 1978. It is not to be confused with the US album of the same name.

It was initially included as part of The Beatles Collection, a box set containing The Beatles’ 12 original albums, but not the Yellow Submarine soundtrack.

The compilation was intended to collate b-sides and non-album recordings such as the World Wildlife Fund version of ‘Across The Universe’ and the Long Tall Sally EP. All the tracks were later included on the Past Masters collection.

Rarities was given a standalone release in the UK on 12 October 1979.
